Resolve the B4-002 acceptance-status mismatch before naming its bytes the accepted owner; otherwise name an exact accepted successor while preserving the same semantics.
Make `CommandSpec` a typed projection consumed by the existing supervisor. Do not let `DockerSbxProvider.exec` invoke arbitrary shell text or own retry/process cleanup policy.
